name: com.doinglab.dietcamera/calorie
title: DietCamera Calorie Dictionary
description: Calories and nutrition for 50,000+ Korean foods, franchise menus and packaged foods.

tools.name: search_food
tools.description: Search the DietCamera calorie dictionary (50,000+ Korean dishes, Korean franchise menus and packaged foods) by name. Use it when the user asks for the calories or nutrition of a food and you need to find matching items. Returns up to 20 items, each with serving size, kcal per serving and per 100 g/ml, carbohydrate, protein, fat, sugars, sodium, an "AI 추정치, 참고용" (AI estimate) flag when values are estimated, and the URL of the source page. Names are matched in Korean, e.g. "김치찌개", "스타벅스 라떼", "불닭볶음면".

query.description: Food name in Korean, optionally with the brand, e.g. "교촌 허니콤보", "김치찌개"

kind.description: Limit to one type: food = general dishes, franchise = restaurant/cafe chain menus, processed = packaged foods

tools.name: get_nutrition
tools.description: Get the full nutrition facts of one food: energy, carbohydrate, sugars, dietary fiber, protein, fat, saturated fat, trans fat, cholesterol and sodium, per serving and per 100 g/ml, with % of the Korean daily reference values. Nutrients the manufacturer has not disclosed are marked "제조사 미공개" (not disclosed), and estimated values carry an "AI 추정치, 참고용" flag. Includes the source page URL. If no exact name match exists, the closest match is returned and similar names are listed.

food.description: Korean food name, a foodNumber, or a https://dietcamera.doinglab.com/food/... page URL returned by search_food

tools.name: compare_foods
tools.description: Compare 2 to 10 foods side by side: serving size, kcal per serving and per 100 g/ml, carbohydrate, protein, fat, sugars and sodium, sorted by calories. Each row links to its source page and carries the AI estimate flag where applicable. Names that cannot be found are reported. Example input: ["짜장면", "짬뽕"], ["빅맥", "와퍼"].

foods.description: 2 to 10 Korean food names, foodNumbers or page URLs

tools.name: franchise_menu
tools.description: List menu items of one Korean franchise brand (e.g. 스타벅스, 맥도날드, 교촌치킨, 배스킨라빈스), sorted by kcal_asc (default), kcal_desc, protein_desc, sugar_asc or sodium_asc. Returns up to 20 items with serving size, calories and macros, the AI estimate flag where applicable, and the URL of the brand page that lists the full menu. Use query to narrow by part of the menu name. If the brand name is ambiguous, the matching brands are listed instead.

brand.description: Brand name as written in Korea, e.g. "스타벅스", "BBQ", "맘스터치"

query.description: Part of the menu name in Korean, e.g. "라떼", "버거"

sort.description: Sort order (default kcal_asc: lowest calories first)

tools.name: new_menus
tools.description: List new menu items that Korean franchise brands published official nutrition information for in a given month, sorted by calories (up to 20). Leave month empty for the latest month. Returns the brands of that month and the URL of the monthly guide page with the full list. Use brand to narrow the list.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Empty = latest month
